case_title: STATE OF J & K v. WASIM AHMED MALIK@ HAMID
statutory_provisions: TADA s. 15, s. 120-B r/w s. 302, 307 and 34 IPC; s. 4 and 5 Explosives Substances Act
confession: Confession of accused recorded under s. 15 of TADA Act, relied on
aggravating_circumstances: Bomb blasts resulting in death of 8 persons and serious injuries to 18 persons
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleged that three bomb explosions occurred on 26.01.1995 at the Maulana Azad Memorial Stadium in Jammu during the Republic Day celebrations, resulting in the death of eight persons and serious injuries to eighteen others. The explosions were part of a conspiracy to terrorize the public. The confessional statements of Mohd. lrfan and Ghulam Nabi Guide, recorded under the Terrorist and Disruptive Activities (Prevention) Act, 1987, detailed the planning and execution of the bombings, including the transportation of explosive materials across the border and their placement in strategic locations within the stadium. The confessions described the involvement of multiple individuals in the conspiracy, with the accused playing a role in planting the bombs. The trial court acquitted both accused due to concerns about the language of the confessional statements, but the Supreme Court overturned this decision, finding the confessions admissible and sufficient to establish guilt for Ghulam Nabi Guide.
